blocks.x: Now, when you -- now that you were -- did you and any bass players, did you become friends with any bass players when you came to New York at that time?
Who were some of your friends?
You just mentioned one. I don't -- what's his name?
Blanton. Blanton, of course, and the one who played also cello. What was his name?
Well, did you meet Milt Hinton?
Milt, yeah, and even Major Holly, who was a very dear friend, yes.
